intro: Poznań rewards visitors with a lively Old Town, rich history, and green spaces. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: Trams and buses are run by MPK; tickets are time-based (15 min 4 zł, 45 min 6 zł, 90 min 8 zł).
Ride apps like Uber and Bolt operate in Poznań.
Driving is not recommended in the city centre due to traffic and limited parking.
Walking is pleasant in the compact centre; cycling is okay but bike paths are inconsistent.
No ferries; the Warta river has bridges only.

old-market-square.name: Old Market Square Poznań
old-market-square.hours: Always open · cafés and bars roughly 09:00–late
old-market-square.tip: Come twice: in the morning for the quiet square and after dark for the lit-up town hall.

town-hall.name: Poznań Town Hall
town-hall.price_text: Small entry fee for the museum inside — check on the day
town-hall.hours: Museum hours vary by season — check on the day
town-hall.tip: Stand in front of the clock before noon to watch the billy goats butt heads.

cathedral.name: Poznań Cathedral
cathedral.price_text: Free to enter · small fee for the crypt — check on the day
cathedral.hours: Open daily, closed during services — check on the day
cathedral.tip: Look for the golden chapel and the tombs of the first Polish rulers.

croissant-museum.name: Rogalowe Muzeum (St. Martin's Croissant Museum)
croissant-museum.price_text: Ticketed show — check price on the day
croissant-museum.hours: Sessions through the day — book ahead
croissant-museum.tip: A short, funny show where you learn to fold the local croissant. Good with kids.

stary-rynek-market.name: Market hall under the Old Market Square (Stary Rynek food stalls)
stary-rynek-market.hours: Daytime into evening — check on the day
stary-rynek-market.tip: Try the local Saint Martin's croissant and a plate of pyry (potato) dishes.

ostrow-tumski.name: Ostrów Tumski walk
ostrow-tumski.tip: Cross the river and walk the quiet island where Poznań began. Best at golden hour.

jezyce-walk.name: Jeżyce neighbourhood walk
jezyce-walk.tip: Old tenement streets, murals and small bakeries. Wander without a map.

jezyce-market.name: Jeżyce food market (Targ Jeżycki)
jezyce-market.hours: Mornings, mainly weekdays — check on the day
jezyce-market.tip: Buy fruit, cheese and bread here for a picnic. Bring cash.

cytadela-park.name: Cytadela Park
cytadela-park.tip: Big green park on an old fort hill. Walk to the war cemetery and the sculpture garden.

lake-malta.name: Lake Malta and the Maltanka railway
lake-malta.price_text: Park free · small fee for the mini railway and ski slope
lake-malta.tip: Rent a bike or take the little train around the lake. Good for a half-day with kids.

wilda-walk.name: Wilda district walk
wilda-walk.tip: Quiet streets, old factories turned into cafés. Walk south from the station.

imperial-castle.name: Imperial Castle (Zamek)
imperial-castle.price_text: Free to enter the courtyard · paid exhibitions
imperial-castle.hours: Daily, hours vary — check on the day
imperial-castle.tip: A strange, grand 1900s palace. The cultural centre inside runs film and art shows.

old-town-tour.name: Old Town walking tour
old-town-tour.price_text: Tip-based or paid — check on the day
old-town-tour.hours: Usually one or two departures a day
old-town-tour.tip: A guide explains the goats, the merchants and the 1956 uprising in about two hours.

croissant-street-food.name: Saint Martin's croissant tasting
croissant-street-food.tip: The local sweet is a flaky croissant filled with poppy seed and nuts. Buy one warm.

cathedral-viewpoint.name: Riverbank view of the cathedral
cathedral-viewpoint.tip: Walk the Warta riverbank for the best photo of the cathedral spires across the water.

stary-browar.name: Stary Browar shopping and art centre
stary-browar.tip: An old brewery turned into shops and a gallery. Good shelter on a wet day.

citadel-museum.name: Museum of Armaments in Cytadela Park
citadel-museum.price_text: Small entry fee — check on the day
citadel-museum.hours: Closed Mondays, seasonal — check on the day
citadel-museum.tip: Small military museum in an old fort. Pair it with a walk in the park.

nightlife-rynek.name: Old Market Square nightlife
nightlife-rynek.hours: Evening into late night, mainly Thursday–Saturday
nightlife-rynek.tip: Bars fill the square's cellars and side streets. Expect busy weekends.

wilda-food-hall.name: Wilda food hall and cafés
wilda-food-hall.hours: Lunch into evening — check on the day
wilda-food-hall.tip: Casual spots near Stary Browar for a cheap, good lunch away from the tourist square.

jezyce-cafe.name: Jeżyce café stop
jezyce-cafe.tip: Small local cafés with good coffee and cake. A quiet break mid-walk.

plans.for: One full day of Old Town history, with the cathedral and a riverbank sunset to finish.

styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Old Town squares, the cathedral and the city's museums.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: St. Martin's croissants, milk bars and craft beer.

styles.label: Budget
styles.blurb: Cheap trams, milk-bar lunches and free squares.

stays.why: Step out onto the main square; most sights and restaurants are walkable. Can be noisy at night.
Leafy streets, cafés and local food spots; a short tram ride to the centre.
Quiet and good value, close to the station and the south bank of the Warta.
Residential and cheapest; near the trade-fair grounds, a longer ride to the Old Town.

food: Try a St. Martin's croissant (rogal świętomarciński) — a poppy-seed pastry with protected status. Buy one from a bakery, not a souvenir stand.
Milk bars (bar mleczny) serve cheap Polish home cooking: soup, pierogi or a schnitzel for well under 30 zł.
Lunch is the main hot meal; many restaurants offer a cheaper 'lunch of the day' (zestaw dnia) on weekdays.
Jeżyce has the best café and brunch scene; the Old Town is more touristy and pricier.
Try local craft beer in the taprooms around the centre; a pint is often 15–25 zł.
more_time: Swap a city afternoon for a half-day trip to Kórnik Castle and its arboretum; check bus times on the day.
Rent a bike or take a tram to Lake Malta for a walk and a summer swim area; check opening hours on the day.
History fans can add the Imperial Castle and the Enigma cipher museum, both in the centre.
